alert.basicDescription: Review the updated defaults before publishing your next project.
alert.actionDescription: Enable it to help keep your workspace secure.
alert.statusProp: Default uses the floating surface, standard border, and default title and description colours. Semantic statuses control the alert's surface, border, and foreground colour.
alert.childrenProp: AlertIcon, AlertTitle, AlertDescription, and AlertAction parts.
alert.classNameProp: Additional classes applied to the alert container.
alert.iconPart: Optional presentational leading icon. It inherits the status colour.
alert.titlePart: Primary message. Use it alone for a compact one-line alert.
alert.descriptionPart: Optional supporting detail. Adding it creates the standard two-line alert.
alert.actionPart: Optional action slot for a button, link, or other compact control. It moves below the content on narrow screens.
